grid.layout_notes: Official Game Description: 6 rows by 6 columns

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: All wins in the current symbol drop are collected and thereafter all symbols which are part of a winning combination explode. Adjacent blocker symbols are also exploded and removed. The remaining symbols fall vertically until they reach a resting position, and new symbols drop in to fill the empty spaces. The Avalanche feature continues as long as new winning combinations appear.

wilds.name: Wild
wilds.behavior: The wild symbol substitutes for any symbol in the main grid except the frog and lily pad symbols.

specials.name: Bomb
specials.behavior:
The bomb symbol causes all blocker symbols within the feature shelf to be removed.
Blocker symbols in the main grid that connect to winning symbols are also removed. Removing all blocker symbols from the main grid in normal mode triggers the bonus mode with free drops.
